To formally reject the possibility that the eukaryotic OSK clade has a sister group relationship to all bacterial sequences in the analysis, we performed topology constraint analyses using the Swofford–Olsen–Waddell–Hillis (SOWH) test, which assigns statistical support to alternative phylogenetic topologies (Swofford et al., 1996).
evidence: This is a result from the statistical topology test, supported by citation to Swofford et al., 1996

claim: The topologies of constrained trees requiring domain of life monophyly or eukaryotic monophyly were significantly worse than the HGT-supporting topology

Members of both of these phyla are also known germ line symbionts of insects (Dunning Hotopp et al., 2007; Zchori-Fein et al., 2004) and other arthropods (Zchori-Fein and Perlman, 2004).
